_about: Level 3's animation frames the user removed (the frame chooser, tools/msxchooser.py), for
tools/msxsprites.py --pool --l3-remove. Empty: every level-3 frame is kept until the user chooses
(docs/LEVEL3.md default 14). bob: 'addr:w:h' (hex) of a frame only level 3 draws -> [the frame
shown instead, dy, dx], or null: a frame the level never draws. The frames level 3 shares with
level 1 follow msx/level1_frames.json, and RoboCop's ('rc') are chosen there only.
